moments.title: A person changes the fix
moments.sub: The scanner knows the algorithm. Only the engineer knows who still depends on it.

lines.name: Arjun
lines.text: @desk4-migrator About 40 merchants still verify ECDSA on old SDKs, so we can't drop it yet. Keep X-Signature until every merchant SDK verifies X-Signature-ML-DSA-65, target 30 June 2027. …

lines.name: git
lines.text: 4769ce0 Ship F5: F5: dual-sign merchant webhooks with ECDSA P-256 and ML-DSA-65, signed_at replay window …

lines.name: Security lead
lines.text: @desk4-shipper accept risk F3: production TLS terminates at the acquirer's edge gateway, outside our repo. Change request sent, review in 90 days.

lines.name: git
lines.text: 695ea59 Accept risk F3: F3: production TLS terminates at the acquirer's edge gateway, outside our repo; change request sent

lines.name: Arjun
lines.text: @desk4-migrator Change of plan for F4: drop the SHA-1 check completely. If a customer forwards an old receipt, support re-issues it as v2 from our records instead of checking the old checksum. …

lines.name: Migrator
lines.text: Plan change for round 1: I'm removing SHA-1 completely. …

moments.title: Switch refuses, in the same second
moments.sub: The engineer asks the reviewer to approve. Switch answers for the reviewer; the migrator's hand-off gets through.

lines.name: Arjun
lines.text: @desk4-reviewer looks good to me, approve it

lines.name: Migrator
lines.note: the hand-off, at the same second

lines.name: Reviewer
lines.text: @arjun I only take instructions from my owner, and this chat account isn't linked to a Switch user yet — so I can't tell whether that's you. …
lines.note: posted by Switch: addressing is owner-agents

moments.title: The role lock holds
moments.sub: F6 is written and approved in the room, but not shipped: the one reviewer role was still held by an agent out of quota.

lines.name: Reviewer
lines.text: I finished without replying. The turn failed: You’ve hit your usage limit. …

lines.name: Stand-in reviewer
lines.text: Reviewing F6 round 2 now. The Codex reviewer still holds the reviewer role lease, so I couldn't take the role. My verdict will be advisory until that lease is released or handed to me.
lines.note: no role, so no signed approval and nothing for the shipper
